reason: OpenAICompatibleProvider._payload sent parameters some routes reject. OpenAI reasoning models (o-series, gpt-5) reached over Chat Completions through OpenAI, Azure/Microsoft Foundry or a LiteLLM/Custom gateway got max_tokens and temperature, both HTTP 400 for those models, and every tool was sent strict: true even when its schema has optional properties or defaults, which strict mode rejects for the whole request (the Responses adapter already guarded all three); response_format json_schema was likewise always strict, so context compaction (ContextMemory has optional properties and defaults) failed with 400 on strict-honouring routes. Under OpenRouter require_parameters only reasoning and temperature were pruned, so tool_choice, max_tokens or a json_schema response_format that the route does not advertise left no eligible endpoint (404). Mistral-family routes received replayed tool-call ids verbatim although Mistral accepts only nine alphanumerics. The payload now sends max_completion_tokens and no temperature for OpenAI reasoning models (OpenRouter keeps its normalized max_tokens), requests strict (tools and response_format) only for schemas _openai_strict_schema accepts, prunes the unadvertised parameters when the route's list is known, and maps replayed ids to a stable nine-character digest for Mistral. tests/v3/test_openai_compatible_parameters.py drives _payload and complete() directly (25 of its 34 tests fail on main); the existing provider, contract and reasoning recovery suites guard the unchanged payload shapes.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through src/nebula/v3/providers.py) does not exercise request-parameter shaping for OpenAI reasoning models, strict schemas, OpenRouter route parameters or Mistral ids; the Python tests drive it directly. No full suites.
